decisions.reason: As a niche but complementary automation module that already outlasted the 2024 robot portfolio shake-out, it is still worth keeping for another year, though after two years its option value is lower and a limited market would now more quickly justify withdrawal.

Because this 2024 launch is close to the core plant offering, appears to have broader application as a multi-model product line, and still has high uncertainty relative to its strategic fit, we would keep the option open.

Production analysis software fits the firm's push toward automated, future-ready plants, is inexpensive to keep relative to machinery, and is useful as a bundle with equipment and services, so we would continue it.
